title: Test-beam sandbox
browse_help: Choose any histogram from the QA ROOT file.
missing: The session container does not exist.
stopped: The session container is not running.
no_qa: No QA result yet. Run: scripts/analyze_session.sh
not_aligned: NOT ALIGNED: QA stopped without numbers. Align first:
changed: POSITIONS CHANGED? The devices seem to have moved since the alignment. Align again:
not_needed: No alignment needed: the setup has no position offsets.
per_event: Tracks per event before / after alignment
illustration: The moving particles illustrate the beam settings of the setup file; they are not recorded events or tracks.
beam_off_note: The beam is off: no particles are drawn.
daq_idle: The DAQ is not running: the beam passes the devices, but nothing is recorded.
controls_help: Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, right-drag or Shift-drag to move.
show_aligned: Show the positions found by alignment
no_webgl: WebGL is not available in this browser, so the 3D view is drawn with SVG (simpler and slower).
no_3d: This browser cannot draw the 3D view; the session state is still shown and updated. Reason:
surveyed: Devices are drawn at the surveyed positions of the setup file.
hidden: The actual positions differ by up to this much in x and y and are not shown (mm):
layout_source: This session was started from a layout directory: positions come from its analysis geometry, and there are no beam settings to draw.
axis_note: Arrow: beam direction (z). Ticks every 10 mm along z.
tile_legend: msensor tiles: orange on, grey off.
ctl_confirm_stop: Stop this run? RunControl starts the next run right away. To end data taking, use End data taking.
ctl_busy: Alignment or QA is already running for this session.
ctl_view_only_hint: This page is view-only. To operate, open the address printed by:
ctl_server_view_only: This page server was started with --view-only; operations are off.
no_session_note: No session is chosen. Start one in the Setup tab, or choose one at the top of the page.
setup_choose: Choose a setup file, or make a new one.
setup_item_help: Values are written as in the file. The small text under each item is the comment the saved file carries.
setup_tiles_click: Tiles: click one to switch it off or on (grey is off).
setup_save_note: Saved only after the check passes, in the folder
setup_exists_confirm: This file already exists. Replace it?
setup_invalid: Not saved: the check found problems.
setup_bad_name: File name: letters, digits, - and _, ending in .ini.
setup_protected: This is a setup file of the repository; save under another name.
start_title: Start a session with this setup
start_needs_save: Save the setup first: the session starts from the saved file.
image_missing: The session image is missing. Build it in a terminal first:
daq_read_note: The text of the window of the session screen, read every second while this tab is shown. Read only.
keys_note: R and T send the RunControl requests repeat and terminate with the session command. Q sends the Q key to the session's RunControl window (rc). What follows is RunControl's own reaction.
key_confirm_t: Send terminate? RunControl ends the sequence.
key_confirm_q: Send Q? RunControl exits; send it after T.
end_steps: As in the README: T, then Q, copy the output, then remove the container.
copy_note: Copied to a new folder under
remove_confirm: Remove the session container? Copy the output first; it is lost with the container.
settings_note: The value is checked as in the setup file and applies when RunControl configures the next run: when this run reaches its event count, or after stop or repeat.
scint_none: No trigger scintillators: every particle while the beam is on is a trigger.
optimiser_before: Track resolution: open in the telescope optimiser for
optimiser_note: External page by Magnus Mager (CERN). The link carries the planes, the beam momentum, the intrinsic resolution of each plane (setup file reference) and 0.107 % X/X0 (100 µm silicon) per plane. Its fit is optimal and has no air, so its value can be a little smaller than this sandbox's estimate, which follows the straight-line fit of the analysis.
choose_histogram: Choose a histogram on the left
ctl_confirm_end: End data taking? RunControl stops the run and ends the sequence; then leave RunControl with Q.
nestdaq_no_qa: QA and histograms are unavailable in nestDAQ mode.
nd_screens_note: Screens open through the page server; the session has no network.
nd_screens_unavailable: Screen links are unavailable in view-only mode or when the request fails.
nd_qa_note: The numbers come from the DQM of the session and are read again every 5 seconds while this tab is shown. They belong to the current run, or to the last run until the next one starts.
nd_qa_pairs: Trigger pairing with the most upstream msensor
nd_qa_none: The DQM has no trigger pairs yet: a session needs at least two msensors, and the pairs appear when the first run starts.
nd_frames_run: Frames sent in this run (all msensors)
material_plane: material, not read in nestDAQ mode
nestdaq_no_histograms: Histograms are unavailable in nestDAQ mode.
